# health-mcp

> FastMCP 3.4+ multi-source health data fusion server. VSM events from devices-mcp, Apple Health import, manual logging, trends.

## Core

- [README](README.md) – Overview, tools, VSM integration
- [llms-full.txt](llms-full.txt) – Full reference for LLMs

## Install

```powershell
uv sync
uv run health-mcp          # stdio (Claude Desktop, Cursor)
```
